[[File:Adamant scimitar detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''adamant scimitar''' is the fourth strongest [[scimitar]] in the game, behind [[Rune scimitar|rune]], [[Gilded scimitar|gilded]] and [[Dragon scimitar|dragon]]. Like most [[adamant weapons]], it requires {{SCP|Attack|30|link=yes}} to wield. 

Players can make it with {{SCP|Smithing|75|link=yes}} using two [[adamantite bar]]s, earning 125 [[experience]]. The scimitar can also be obtained from killing [[monsters]], and is a reward from the quest [[The Feud]]. 

Smithing an adamant scimitar in the [[Resource Area]] is a task for the [[Wilderness Hard Diary]].
